outages.headline: Yemen’s Houthis claim ballistic missile strike on Saudi oil tanker in Red Sea
outages.summary: Yemen’s Houthi group claimed Wednesday that it struck the Saudi oil tanker Wafaa with several ballistic missiles in the northern Red Sea off the coast of Yanbu.
